description: This file defines the 'Delete' feature for articles, including a command, validation, and a handler to delete an article by its slug from the database.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the provided Slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of an article identified by its slug asynchronously.

methods.name: Delete.CommandValidator.CommandValidator
methods.description: Initializes the validator with rules for the Command's Slug property.

methods.name: Delete.QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Handles the deletion logic, retrieves the article, and removes it from the context.
